ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a large rectangle, with six equal-sized circles placed inside, arranged in 3 columns and 2 rows. Adjacent circles are mutually tangent, and the outer circles are also tangent to the sides of the large rectangle. There is also a smaller rectangle in the figure, whose four vertices are respectively located at the centers of the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, and lower-right four circles. Reasoning: Let the radius of each circle be r, then the distance between adjacent circle centers is one diameter, namely 2r. The width of the small rectangle is from the upper-left circle center to the upper-right circle center, spanning two segments of adjacent circle-center distance, so the width is 4r; the height of the small rectangle is from the upper-left circle center to the lower-left circle center, spanning one segment of adjacent circle-center distance, so the height is 2r. The perimeter of the small rectangle is 60 cm, therefore 2(4r+2r)=60, namely 12r=60, obtaining r=5. The large rectangle encloses 3 columns and 2 rows of circles, so the width is 3 diameters, namely 6r; the height is 2 diameters, namely 4r. The perimeter of the large rectangle is 2(6r+4r)=20r=20×5=100.

From the text, its perimeter is 60 cm, so 2(4r+2r)=60, giving r=5. The large rectangle is tangent around the full 3-by-2 circle block, so its width is 3 diameters = 6r and its height is 2 diameters = 4r. Its perimeter is 2(6r+4r)=20r=100.

From the image, the small rectangle’s width covers two equal horizontal center gaps, while its height covers one equal vertical center gap, so its width is twice its height. claims.source: The perimeter of the small rectangle is 60 cm

claims.claim: From the perimeter of the small rectangle being 60 cm, we can get 2(4r+2r)=60, therefore r=5.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The perimeter of the small rectangle is 60 cm, therefore 2(4r+2r)=60, that is 12r=60, obtaining r=5

claims.claim: The width of the large rectangle is 3 diameters, that is 6r.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: So the width is 3 diameters, namely 6r

claims.claim: The height of the large rectangle is 2 diameters, namely 4r.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The height is 2 diameters, namely 4r

claims.claim: Substitute r=5, the perimeter of the large rectangle is 2(6r+4r)=20r=100 cm.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The perimeter of the large rectangle is 2(6r+4r)=20r=20×5=100
